# Cost

## COST-1 Reuse a session
roles: manager
topic: cost

The Manager reuses a session while it stays on one task.

## COST-3 Reuse rule
roles: manager
topic: cost

The Manager reuses a session while context is under the limit.

## COST-4 Fresh rule
roles: manager
topic: cost

The Manager starts a fresh session once context is over the limit.
